result.topic_en: Calculations on one-dimensional gas flow (Riemann's air-wave / shock theory): the derivation of the Riemann invariants for the adiabatic law $p=aa\rho^k$, the reduction to the linear Euler–Poisson–Darboux type equation in the characteristic variables p, q, and its solution by power series, Fourier integrals and hypergeometric (P-function) integrals.
result.transcription:
$\frac{1}{\rho}\frac{\partial \rho}{\partial x} = -\frac{\partial u}{\partial t} - u\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$
$\frac{\partial \rho}{\partial t} + \frac{\partial \rho u}{\partial x} = 0$

$p = aa\rho^{\sigma}$
$dQ = \mathfrak{A}\,d\rho + \mathfrak{B}\,d\sigma$ [?]
$K\,d\sigma = \mathfrak{A}\rho\frac{d\rho}{\rho} + \mathfrak{B}\,d\sigma$ [?]
$\mathfrak{A} = \frac{(\mathfrak{u} - \mathfrak{B})\sigma}{v}$ [?]
$(k-1)\frac{d\rho}{\rho} = \frac{d\sigma}{\sigma}$
$\sigma = Const.\,\rho^{k-1}$
$p = aa\rho^k$

$\log \rho = s$
$aa k e^{s(k-1)}\frac{\partial s}{\partial x} = -\frac{\partial u}{\partial t} - u\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = -\frac{\partial s}{\partial t} - u\frac{\partial s}{\partial x}$ [?]
$u + \varphi(s) = 2p$ $\quad \varphi'(s) = a\sqrt{k}\,e^{s\frac{k-1}{2}} = \sqrt{k\frac{p}{\rho}}$
$\varphi(s) = a\frac{2\sqrt{k}}{k-1}e^{s\frac{k-1}{2}}$ [-+const-]
$\varphi'(s)\frac{\partial p}{\partial x} = -\frac{\partial p}{\partial t} - u\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}$
$\frac{\partial p}{\partial t} = -(u+\varphi'(s))\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}$
$\frac{\partial q}{\partial t} = -(u-\varphi'(s))\frac{\partial q}{\partial x}$
$u = p - q$
$\varphi(s) = p + q$
$\varphi'(s)\frac{\partial s}{\partial p} = 1$
$\frac{\partial x}{\partial q} = +(u+\varphi'(s))\frac{\partial t}{\partial q}$
$\frac{\partial x}{\partial p} = +(u-\varphi'(s))\frac{\partial t}{\partial p}$
$\frac{\partial \log\varphi'(s)}{\partial s} = \frac{k-1}{2}$
[-$2\varphi'(s)\frac{\partial^2 t}{\partial p\partial q} + \frac{\partial t}{\partial q}(1+\varphi''(s)\frac{\partial s}{\partial p}) + \frac{\partial t}{\partial p}(1+\varphi''(s)\frac{\partial s}{\partial q}) = 0$-]
$\frac{4\varphi(s)}{k+1}\frac{\partial^2 t}{\partial p\partial q} + \frac{\partial t}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial t}{\partial q} = 0$
$\frac{\partial(x - (u+\varphi'(s))t)}{\partial q} = -t\frac{\partial(u+\varphi'(s))}{\partial q} = t\frac{k+1}{2}$
$\frac{\partial(x - (u-\varphi'(s))t)}{\partial p} = -t\frac{\partial(u-\varphi'(s))}{\partial p} = -t\frac{k+1}{2}$
$(x - \overline{u+\varphi'(s)}\,t)\,dp - (x - \overline{(u-\varphi'(s))}\,t)\,dq = dw$
$\frac{\partial w}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial q} = 2\varphi'(s)t = -\frac{4\varphi(s)}{k+1}\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial p\partial q} = -\frac{4}{k+1}(p+q)\frac{k-1}{2}\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial p\partial q}$
$\iint\left(2\frac{k-1}{k+1}(p+q)\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial p\partial q} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial q}\right)v\,\partial p\,\partial q = \iint\left(2\frac{k-1}{k+1}\frac{\partial^2(p+q)v}{\partial p\partial q} - \frac{\partial v}{\partial p} - \frac{\partial v}{\partial q}\right)w\,\partial p\,\partial q + \int w\left(w + 2\frac{k-1}{k+1}\overline{p+q}\frac{\partial w}{\partial p}\right)dp + w\left(2\frac{k-1}{k+1}\frac{\partial(p+q)v}{\partial q} - v\right)\partial q$
$p = p'$) $2\frac{k-1}{k+1}\frac{\partial(p+q)v}{\partial q} - v = 0$ $\quad 2\frac{k-1}{k+1}(p+q)\frac{\partial v}{\partial q} + \frac{k-3}{k+1}v = 0$ $\quad \frac{\partial v}{v} = -\frac{k-3}{2(k-1)}\partial\log(p+q)$
$v = Const\,(p+q)^{-\frac{k-3}{2(k-1)}} = Const\,(p+q)^{-\frac12+\frac{1}{k-1}}$
$q = q'$) $2\frac{k-1}{k+1}\frac{\partial(p+q)v}{\partial p} - v = 0$ $\quad \left.\begin{matrix}q=q'\\p=p'\end{matrix}\right)$ $p+q$ [?] $v = 1$
$p+q = \sigma$ $\quad p - q = u$ $\quad \frac{\partial w}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial q} = 2\frac{\partial w}{\partial \sigma}$ $\quad \frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial p\partial q} = \frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial\sigma^2} - \frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial u^2}$
$\frac{k-1}{k+1}\left(\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial\sigma^2} - \sigma\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial\omega^2}\right) - \frac{\partial v}{\partial\sigma} = 0$ $\quad v = e^{\mu u}\Sigma a_n\sigma^n$
$\Sigma\, a_n n(n+1 - \frac{k+1}{k-1})\sigma^{n-1} - \Sigma a_n\mu\mu\sigma^{n+1}$
$a_n\frac{\Pi n\,\Pi(n - \frac{1}{k-1})2^{2n}}{\mu^{2n}} = Const.$
$v = e^{\mu u}\Sigma\frac{(\frac{\sigma\mu}{2})^{2n}}{\Pi(n)\Pi(n-\frac{1}{k-1})} = e^{\mu u}\Sigma\frac{(\frac{\sigma\mu}{2})^{2n}}{\Pi n}\int e^{x}x^{-n+\frac{1}{k-1}-1}\partial x = \int e^{\mu u + x + \frac{(\sigma\mu)^2}{4x}}x^{\frac{1}{k-1}-1}\partial x = (\frac{\sigma\mu}{2})^{\frac{1}{k-1}}\int e^{\frac{\mu}{2}(p(x+\frac1x+2)+q(x+\frac1x-2))}x^{\frac{1}{k-1}-1}\partial x$
$v = (p+q)^{\frac{1}{k-1}}\int f\left(\frac{(x+1)^2}{x}p + \frac{(x-1)^2}{x}q\right)x^{\frac{1}{k-1}-1}\partial x$
$v = (p+q)^{\frac{1}{k-1}}\int\left(\frac{(x+1)^2}{x}p + \frac{(x-1)^2}{x}q\right)^{-\frac{1}{k-1}}x^{\frac{1}{k-1}-1}\partial x$
$= \int(x - e^{2\varphi i})^{-\frac{1}{k-1}}(1 - xe^{-2\varphi i})^{-\frac{1}{k-1}}x^{-1}\partial x = P\begin{pmatrix}0 & & 0 & \\ \frac{1}{k-1} & & 1-\frac{2}{k-1} & e^{4\varphi i}\end{pmatrix} = P\begin{pmatrix}0 & \frac{1}{k-1} & 0 & \\ \frac12 & \frac{1}{k-1} & \frac12 - \frac{1}{k-1} & \end{pmatrix}$ [?]
$\sqrt{p} + \sqrt{q}\,i = re^{\varphi i}$
$\frac{x-1}{x+1} = \sqrt{\frac{p}{q}}\,i$ $\quad x = \frac{\sqrt{q}+\sqrt{p}\,i}{-(\sqrt{q}+\sqrt{p}\,i)} = e^{2\varphi i}$ [?]
$v = (p+q)^{-\frac12+\frac{1}{k-1}}\int(1 - xe^{-2\varphi i})^{-\frac12}(1 - xe^{2\varphi i})^{-\frac12}x^{\frac{1}{k-1}-\frac12}\partial x$
$P\begin{pmatrix}0 & \frac12 & 0 & e^{4\varphi i}\\ 0 & \frac12 - \frac{1}{k-1} & \frac{1}{k-1} & \end{pmatrix}$
$\int s^{-1+\frac{1}{k-1}}(1-s)^{-1+\frac{1}{k-1}}\partial s$

$\frac{k-1}{k+1}\frac{\partial^2(z^2+y^2)v}{\partial x\partial y} - y\frac{\partial v}{\partial x} - x\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}$ [?]
$x + yi = z$
$x - yi = z'$
$\frac{k-1}{k+1}i\left(\frac{\partial^2 zz' v}{\partial z^2} - \frac{\partial^2 zz'v}{\partial z'^2}\right) + \frac{\partial v}{\partial z}(-y - xi) + \frac{\partial v}{\partial z'}(-y+xi)$
$\frac{\partial v}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial v}{\partial z} + \frac{\partial v}{\partial z'}$
$\frac{k-1}{k+1}\left(z'\frac{\partial^2(zv)}{\partial z^2} - z\frac{\partial^2 z'v}{\partial z'^2}\right) + z\frac{\partial v}{\partial z} + z'\frac{\partial v}{\partial z'} = 0$
$\frac{\partial v}{\partial x\partial y} = z'\left(\frac{\partial\frac{\partial v}{\partial z}}{\partial z}\right) \pm \frac{\cdots}{k-1}$ [?]

$\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial\sigma^2} - \sigma\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial\omega^2} - \frac{k+1}{k-1}\frac{\partial v}{\partial\sigma} = 0$ $\quad u = p - q \quad \sigma = p + q$
$v = e^{\mu u}\Sigma a_n\sigma^n$
$\Sigma a_n(n(n-1) - \frac{k+1}{k-1})\sigma^{n-1} - \Sigma a_n\mu\mu\sigma^{n+1} = \Sigma\frac{(\frac{\sigma\mu}{2})^{2n}}{\Pi n\,\Pi(n-\frac{1}{k-1})} = \frac{(\frac{\sigma\mu}{2})^{2n}}{\Pi n}\int e^{x}x^{-n+\frac{1}{k-1}-1}\partial x = \int e^{x+\frac{(\sigma\mu)^2}{4x}}x^{\frac{1}{k-1}-1}\partial x$
$a_n\frac{\Pi n\,\Pi(n-\frac{1}{k-1})2^{2n}}{\mu^{2n}} = Const.$
$= (\frac{\sigma\mu}{2})^{\frac{1}{k-1}}\int e^{\frac{\sigma\mu}{2}(x+\frac1x)}x^{\frac{1}{k-1}-1}\partial x$
$= \frac{1}{\Pi n}$
$2(p+q)\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial p\partial q} + \frac{k+1}{k-1}\cdot\frac12\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial q}\right) = 0$
$\sigma\left(\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial\sigma^2} - \frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial u^2}\right) + \frac{k+1}{k-1}\frac{\partial w}{\partial\sigma} = 0$
$w = e^{\mu u}\Sigma a_n\sigma^n$, $0 = \Sigma a_n n(n-1+\frac{k+1}{k-1})\sigma^{n-1} - \Sigma\mu\mu a_n\sigma^{n+1}$ $\quad \Sigma a_n\sigma^n(\frac{\sigma\mu}{2})^{-\frac{1}{k-1}}\int e^{\frac{\sigma\mu}{2}(x+\frac1x)}x^{-\frac{1}{k-1}}\partial x$
$\Sigma a_n\sigma^n = \Sigma\frac{(\frac{\sigma\mu}{2})^{2n}}{\Pi n\,\Pi(n+\frac{1}{k-1})} = f(\mu\sigma)$ $\quad \Sigma_{-\frac{1}{k-1},\infty} = \varphi(\mu\sigma)$
[-$w = \int_0^\infty(\varphi(\mu)\cos\mu u + \psi(\mu)\sin\mu u)f(\mu\sigma)\partial\mu$-]
$\frac{\partial w}{\partial\sigma} = \int_0^\infty(\varphi(\mu)\cos\mu u + \psi(\mu)\sin\mu u)\mu f'(\mu\sigma)\partial\mu$
$\cos\mu u\,(\chi(\mu)f(\mu\sigma') + \psi(\mu)\varphi(\mu\sigma')) = \frac1\pi\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}w'\cos\mu u'\partial u'$
$\cos\mu u\,(\chi(\mu)f'(\mu\sigma') + \psi(\mu)\varphi'(\mu\sigma')) = \frac{1}{\mu\pi}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{\partial w'}{\partial\sigma'}\cos\mu u'\partial u'$
[-$w = \frac1\pi\int_0^\infty\cos\mu u\,\partial\mu\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}w'\cos\mu u'\partial u' + \frac1\pi\int_0^\infty\sin\mu u\,\partial\mu\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}w'\sin\mu u'\partial u'$-]
$\chi(\mu) = \frac{\frac1\pi\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\cos\mu u'\left(w'\varphi'(\mu\sigma') - \frac{\partial w'}{\partial\sigma'}\frac{\varphi(\mu\sigma')}{\mu}\right)\partial u'}{f(\mu\sigma')\varphi'(\mu\sigma') - \varphi(\mu\sigma')f'(\mu\sigma')}$
$\frac{\partial w}{\partial\sigma} = \frac1\pi$
$w = \int_0^\infty \cos\mu$ [?]
$\frac{y\frac{\partial y'}{\partial\sigma} - y'\frac{\partial y}{\partial\sigma}}{\sigma} = \frac{y'\frac{\partial^2 y}{\partial\sigma^2} - y\frac{\partial^2 y'}{\partial\sigma^2}}{} \cdot\frac{k-1}{k+1}$
$y\frac{\partial y'}{\partial\sigma} - y'\frac{\partial y}{\partial\sigma} = const.\,\sigma^{-\frac{k+1}{k-1}}$
$w = \frac1\pi\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\int_0^\infty\cos\mu(u-u')\partial u'\,(\mu\sigma')^{\frac{k+1}{k-1}}\left(w'\varphi'(\mu\sigma')f(\mu\sigma) - \varphi(\mu\sigma)f(\mu\sigma')\right) - \frac{\partial w'}{\partial\sigma'}\frac1\mu\left(\varphi(\mu\sigma')f(\mu\sigma) - \varphi(\mu\sigma)f(\mu\sigma')\right)\partial\mu$
$\delta p = -\delta q = \frac12\delta w$
$\frac{\partial w}{\partial p} = \frac{\partial w}{\partial u} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial\sigma}$
$\frac{\partial w}{\partial q} = \frac{\partial w}{\partial\sigma} - \frac{\partial w}{\partial u}$
[-$\int\frac{\partial w}{\partial\sigma}\frac{k-1}{k+1}\ldots$-]
$\int\frac{k-1}{k+1}\frac{\partial w}{\partial\sigma}\,\partial w$ $\quad = 2\frac{k-1}{k+1}(v\,\overline{p+q}\,\frac{\partial w}{\partial p})_{q,q'}$ [?]
$v = \frac1\pi\int_0^\infty\cos\mu(u-u')(\mu\sigma')^{\frac{2}{k-1}}\left(\varphi(\mu\sigma')f(\mu\sigma) - f(\mu\sigma')\varphi(\mu\sigma)\right)\partial\mu$

$a+b+1 = \alpha - \alpha'$
$b+c+1 = \beta - \beta'$
$b+c+1 = \gamma' - \gamma$
$(\alpha+\frac12)(p+q) + 2p - 2q + 2K$
$K - q' = q'$
$z + \frac{p-q}{p+q}$

methods.what: Adiabatic pressure–density law derived from entropy-type relation
Riemann invariants: sound-speed function and characteristic variables

methods.quote:
$\frac{\partial p}{\partial t} = -(u+\varphi'(s))\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}$
$\frac{\partial q}{\partial t} = -(u-\varphi'(s))\frac{\partial q}{\partial x}$

methods.what: Hodograph transformation: linear second-order PDE for t in the variables p, q
methods.quote: $\frac{4\varphi(s)}{k+1}\frac{\partial^2 t}{\partial p\partial q} + \frac{\partial t}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial t}{\partial q} = 0$

methods.what: Potential w defined by an exact differential, satisfying a linear PDE
Green-type integration by parts with adjoint operator (Riemann's method for hyperbolic equations)
methods.quote: $\iint\left(2\frac{k-1}{k+1}(p+q)\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial p\partial q} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial q}\right)v\,\partial p\,\partial q = \iint\left(2\frac{k-1}{k+1}\frac{\partial^2(p+q)v}{\partial p\partial q} - \frac{\partial v}{\partial p} - \frac{\partial v}{\partial q}\right)w\,\partial p\,\partial q

methods.what: Boundary values of the Riemann function along characteristics
Integral representation of the series solution
Riemann function expressed as hypergeometric integral / P-function
Wronskian relation for the two solutions
Fourier-integral solution of initial value problem
Fourier-integral form of the Riemann function v
Transformation to complex variables z, z'
methods.quote: $\frac{k-1}{k+1}\left(z'\frac{\partial^2(zv)}{\partial z^2} - z\frac{\partial^2 z'v}{\partial z'^2}\right) + z\frac{\partial v}{\partial z} + z'\frac{\partial v}{\partial z'} = 0$
